checks.name: three original rooms contain ten accessible gems and reachable optional treasure
starting and selecting stages rebuild world without consuming a play
first gem is collected by real movement in under a quarter second
diagonal input is normalized and cannot increase movement speed
perimeter and obstacle collision remain solid through long held input
swept dash cannot tunnel through a single tile or cut a corner
dash has a real cooldown, remembers heading and does not mutate paused games
contact loses one heart and grants enough protection to leave a hazard
dashing a foe knocks and stuns it without killing it or losing health
spikes clearly warn before becoming active and are never a one-hit trap
seven gems keep the exit locked; the eighth opens it and exit contact wins once
treasure needs the optional key, consumes it and awards the bonus only once
deadline is thirty simulated seconds and warnings occur only once
pause freezes time, hazards, movement, effects and cooldown then resumes safely
fixed simulation matches at 30 and 120 fps, and ignores invalid time/input
cancel and unfinished reload discard unearned score but preserve earned records
malformed or inconsistent local records recover to a finite fresh state
snapshots and map templates cannot mutate an active run or a subsequent retry
all rooms can be won through public movement without dash or fixture assistance
